issues.summary: plan-v1.md P6.6 references pipeline stages by number ('Stage 15 — Stage 13 in v4.5.0+ numbering'), violating the recipe-feature-pipeline SKILL.md discipline 5 (no pipeline-stage references by number; stage taxonomy is by name only; codified in ADR-0028).

evidence.quote: P6.6 — Deliverable packaging (Stage 15 — Stage 13 in v4.5.0+ numbering)
No pipeline-stage references by number. Stage taxonomy is by name only (Intent Clarification, PRD Authoring, etc.); filenames are semantic. Per the v4.3.1 surgery.

evidence.note: User has explicitly acknowledged this finding (2026-05-21 post-Gate-5 review) with disposition 'address later'. Cross-Artifact Audit MUST surface independently per ADR-0029.

issues.root_cause_summary: Plan-author attempted to bridge old (pre-v4.4) and current numbering for reader-disambiguation; intent was clarity, vehicle (numbers) was the violation. See observations.md OBS-PLAN-001 for full root-cause analysis.
issues.recommended_resolution: Reconciliation supersedes plan-v1.md → plan-v1.1.0.md per ADR-0005 with P6.6 heading rewritten as: 'P6.6 — Deliverable packaging (added as a new stage in v4.5.0+)' — preserving the historical-context value without numbers. Body content unchanged.
issues.severity_rationale: MAJOR not BLOCKER: feature execution can proceed without this fix; the discipline violation is in a planning artifact, not in shipped code. MAJOR not MINOR: discipline is explicitly codified in ADR-0028; silent allowance would be a precedent against the discipline.

issues.summary: AT-030 (FR-12-c behavior equivalence) and PV-1.C4/C5 require an intermediate-state real-repo audit capture (`/tmp/post-dedup-audit.json`) taken at the post-dedup / pre-mechanism-α-wiring moment. Plan P1.4 does not produce this capture: its sub-steps 1-6 bundle dedup + the mechanism-α justification_valid helper + the wiring of that helper + the input-schema parser changes + the fence-parser changes — all into a single phase whose stated verification is 'pre/post-fix audit on a FIXTURE (NOT the real repo yet)'. The verification AC-FR-12-c reads 'audit output ... for every input the existing audit corpus exercises' which is the real-corpus reading; fixture-only verification does not satisfy it; AT-030 and PV-1 both interpret correctly; Plan P1.4 does not.

evidence.quote: Verification: pre/post-fix audit on a fixture (NOT the real repo yet)
After FR-12 is applied but BEFORE FR-7 mechanism-α rejection logic is wired (intermediate state), capture `/tmp/post-dedup-audit.json`. (Plan P1.4's verification step is the natural moment.)
`/tmp/post-dedup-audit.json` exists, captured at the post-P1.4-pre-FR-7-wiring moment
Verified by running the audit before and after deduplication and confirming finding-line equality

issues.secondary_complication: Plan P1.4 step 5 also changes the input-schema parser (from bare-list to structured-dict form). Existing markers in the repo are in bare-list form. After step 5 applies, the audit's reading of those markers changes — independent of mechanism-α wiring (step 4). So 'modulo mechanism-α findings' alone is insufficient for behavior equivalence; the comparison must also bracket the schema-form change. The cleanest moment for the intermediate capture is between current step 3 (helper authored but not wired, parser unchanged) and step 4 (wiring + parser changes follow).
issues.recommended_resolution: Reconciliation supersedes plan-v1.md → plan-v1.1.0.md with Plan P1.4 amended: (a) insert new step '3.5: Capture intermediate audit — `python3 .claude/skills/auditing-cc-configs/scripts/audit_project.py . --json > /tmp/post-dedup-audit.json`. This captures the post-dedup / pre-mechanism-α / pre-schema-change state for AT-030 + PV-1.C5.' (b) Update the Verification line to: 'pre/post-fix audit on the real repo at step 3.5 confirms behavior equivalence (AC-FR-12-c, AT-030); fixture-based negative test after step 6 confirms new rejection behavior (AT-021).' Alternative resolution: rewrite AT-030 + PV-1.C4/C5 to compare the FINAL audit filtered for both mechanism-α findings AND schema-form-derived deltas — but this is brittle and changes acceptance-tests.md substantively.
issues.severity_rationale: MAJOR not BLOCKER: the AC is satisfiable with either resolution; not unfixable. MAJOR not MINOR: as currently written, AT-030 cannot be executed (the artifact it needs isn't produced), so the AC verification path is broken.

issues.summary: Plan P1.3's auditing-shared SKILL.md content listing names two canonical scripts (`pedagogical_marker_check.py` AND `scan_memory_secrets.py`). The first is created in Plan P1.4 (same phase, consistent). The second is created in Plan P4.2 (three phases later). SKILL.md authored at P1.3 will list a file that doesn't yet exist in the file system until P4.2 — a temporal inconsistency between the documented contents and the actual contents.

evidence.quote: ## Contents\n- `scripts/pedagogical_marker_check.py` — canonical pedagogical-marker triage with mechanism-α enforcement (per ADR-0030)\n- `scripts/scan_memory_secrets.py` — canonical memory-secrets scan

Create canonical at `auditing-shared/scripts/scan_memory_secrets.py` (identical to either prior copy). Replace `auditing-context-files/scripts/scan_memory_secrets.py` + `auditing-subagents/scripts/scan_memory_secrets.py` per P4.1 pattern.

issues.recommended_resolution: Two options for reconciliation: (a) Move scan_memory_secrets.py creation into Phase 1 (renumber P1.5 or P1.4-extended), so SKILL.md's content listing is accurate when authored. (b) Author SKILL.md at P1.3 with only the `pedagogical_marker_check.py` entry; amend SKILL.md in P4.2 to add `scan_memory_secrets.py` to the Contents list. Option (a) is cleaner (one phase, two related canonicals); option (b) preserves the existing phase ordering. Plan-author / reconciler chooses.
issues.severity_rationale: MINOR: the inconsistency is in documentation timing, not in functional outcome. End-state is correct; only the intermediate-state SKILL.md briefly describes a file that doesn't exist yet.
